summary: Persist bounded safe terminal failures for frozen Reference items and reject literal Building/Bldg identity substitution without adding semantic preprocessing.
decision_refs: The staged fixed-15 run required multiple continuation tasks because contract-rejected questions remained pending
S4 passed structural validation while answering Building G for a Building I question
The active user goal keeps task and result management local while avoiding pre-model engineering-semantic reconstruction
approval_evidence: The user directed continued implementation of the management-first Reference framework while preserving existing behavior.
known_limitations: Only compact literal Building/Bldg identifiers are checked; other entity classes remain future evidence-driven extensions.
A terminal failed item is immutable; testing a changed prompt or model requires a new frozen evaluation rather than an automatic retry.
The change does not improve or rescore the historical fixed-15 live run by itself.
